title: Math Proofs
description: Mathematical proofs as rows: claims about rows in one JSON term language, checked by tiers honest about what they established (numeric witness, interval decision, SymPy over symbols, Z3 over the continuum and machine integers within a budget, Lean via an engines worker); inference rules that generate the obligations a tensor tree's structure demands — the logic between its parts (plan §I) — at boot and on demand.

engines.name: lean
engines.note: Lean 4 + Mathlib formal tier (pf-2) — served by the polari-proof-tools engines worker (polari-rf-node/polari-proof-tools, :9810); resolved through the engines ladder (PROOF_ENGINES_URL → local project → local image polari-proof-tools:noble → topology provider mathproofs.engines via `pol allocate mathproofs.engines <instance>` → refusal by name); never run automatically

requires.engines_note: z3 (tier 2, pf-1) is a python library (z3-solver, MIT) and runs in-process within each claim's budget_s; sympy is present
